title: Final Frequency Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct equation for the frequency of the reflected photon, nu' = nu(1 + 2beta cos(theta_i) + beta^2) / (1 - beta^2).

title: Final Angle Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct equation for the cosine of the reflected angle, cos(theta_r) = ((1 + beta^2) cos(theta_i) + 2beta) / (1 + 2beta cos(theta_i) + beta^2).

title: Mirror Velocity Impact
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain how the direction of the mirror's velocity affects the reflection process, noting that motion in the y-direction does not change the angle or frequency.

title: Reflection Angle Consistency
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly state that if the mirror moves in the y-direction, then theta_r = theta_i.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations, particularly for frequency and angle.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the transformation equations, particularly with the cosine terms.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as gamma and beta, are included in the final equations.
